comment: PROVISIONAL configurable values for MVP. Ranges are conventional sports-nutrition practice, not medical prescriptions. Review with a qualified professional before production.

training_session_kcal_per_min.comment: Provisional per-minute training energy additions by intensity, added on top of daily-activity TDEE for training sessions to avoid double counting (daily activity factor here reflects NON-training activity).

match_kcal.comment: Provisional energy addition for a football match day (90 min match, includes warm-up).

protein_g_per_kg.comment: Provisional protein targets per kg body weight by sport and goal-direction.

carb_g_per_kg_min.comment: Provisional minimum carbs for endurance sports on training/match days.
